title: JIT miscompilation in the DOM: Core & HTML component
description: CVE-2026-12299 is a vulnerability involving a JIT miscompilation issue in the DOM Core and HTML components of Microsoft software version 4.0. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-843, which relates to improper control flow or logic errors in code generation. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and there are no known exploits in the wild. No patch or remediation details are available in the provided data.
